company.shortDescription: Tutorspree is an online platform that offers web based tuition services for the U.S students on various subjects.
company.description:
Tutorspree is an online platform that offers web based tuition services for the U.S students on various subjects. It provides tutoring services in the fields of math, social studies, language, science, programming, and English.


Tutorspree solves the discovery, matching, scheduling, and payment inefficiencies in a $7B domestic market by combining its deep and growing roster of over 5000 active tutors with technology that creates ideal unions between students and tutors.


Tutorspree was established in 2010 and is based in New York, N.Y.
